title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode8 Chasing Shadows

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this, Mafuyu?
We don't mean to drag you along.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I was actually hoping to take a breather today anyway.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear!
Let's have as much fun as we can today!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Rare item: Print Stickers with Mafuyu, obtained!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My skin looks so good in these photos. What a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's the selling point of this machine, after all. I actually like the one over there a little more. Wanna give it a try next?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Check out this blouse! Isn't it adorable?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, it is. And it suits you very well.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh, Mafuyu, I bet this skirt would look great on you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You think so? I do own a few clothes with similar designs, I think.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. There's a shop that I was hoping to visit. Can we go there next?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Still, Mafuyu, I didn't realize you liked these kinds of shops.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been meaning to visit it after spotting it on my way home the other day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, I see! I don't usually wear these kinds of clothes, but it's fun just looking at them, huh.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Since we're here, let's have a good look around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Are you looking for anything in particular?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're right about that!
I also really love all the clothes we have here♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, miss, you look very grown-up, so I might have a dress that suits you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We just got it in the other day.
Would you like to take a look at it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you don't have to try it on!
I just personally think that you'd look really amazing in it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay. Then, maybe just a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you!
Right this way...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had so much fun today.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Don't act like the day's over.
We can't go home until we've had these pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Their heart-shaped fruit pancakes are very famous. Anyway, let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This whipped cream isn't too terribly sweet, so I can just keep on eating.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Me too! I might have room for seconds!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Uh, wouldn't that be going a little overboard?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
These pancakes are just that good!
Apparently they have different flavors for different seasons too. I wonder what they are.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's come back again some day when Mafuyu's free!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
I hope Yoisaki can join us next time.
She said she couldn't today because she'd be busy working on a song.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
She's really famous online, right?
Do you think that means she writes new songs every single day?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I'm sure she's free sometimes. Let's invite her again sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you like it?
I tried preparing it a little differently today, so I'm glad you're enjoying it so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Everything you make is good, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mafuyu, have you already decided which school you're going to apply to?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You mentioned a little while back that you'd like to become a doctor, so I figured that you'd be trying for schools with medical programs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, about that... We actually discussed that the other day. Mafuyu said...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She isn't completely set on becoming a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It sounds like she wishes to do something that allows her to be there for people. So I think we should give her time to think it over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
You wish to be there for people. You really do have a big heart, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Regardless of the path you choose in life, I'm sure you'll find a way to succeed, Mafuyu.
